messages:
Eli (sales): Hey team — ACME POC just started a stress ramp and they're getting intermittent 429s on embeddings. Can we swarm for quick triage?
Marin (solutions): On it. Jordan, can you paste the exact response body + headers (Retry-After)? Also which endpoint are you hitting: `/v1/embeddings` or chat/generate?
Jordan (ACME POC): `/v1/embeddings`. Here's the curl output from their harness:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
Retry-After: 3
{ "error": "rate_limited", "message": "per-route capacity exceeded" }
```
Keiko (support): Thanks — is this a Hosted trial or Dedicated? Any custom per-route caps in the tenant settings?
Jordan (ACME POC): Hosted trial. We're running batch_size=32, concurrency=12. Avg doc ~600 tokens.
Devon (eng): That batch/concurrency combo is pretty aggressive for embeddings. 32 * 600 ~= 19.2k tokens per batch. Our embedding path enforces a per-route rps cap for POC tenants — token count influences backend load but the immediate limiter is requests/sec. Large batches can still congest GPU/IO and trigger the per-route cap.
Priya (oncall): Can someone pull their tenant's Request/sec chart + per-route cap from the console? Need timestamps for when 429s started.
Jordan (ACME POC): Console shows a spike to ~120 rps at 2025-11-02T12:02:14Z, 429s begin 12:03:01Z. Retry-After is consistently 3s. Dashboard shows per-route cap for embeddings = 50 rps (default POC).
Marin (solutions): That explains it — they exceeded the 50 rps default. Two immediate options: 1) throttle client (reduce concurrency & batch), 2) request a temporary per-route uplift for the demo.
Eli (sales): Customer has a live demo in ~2 hours. Can we do a short uplift? What do you need from me to approve? :pray:
Devon (eng): I can apply a temporary uplift to 200 rps for their embeddings route for up to 3 hours. Need: tenant_id, exact time window, and sales approval recorded in the ticket (audit). Also will add an automatic revert.
Keiko (support): Jordan, please change client to batch_size=8 and concurrency=6 immediately and re-run to confirm if it stabilizes while we process uplift. That will also reduce token spikes.
Jordan (ACME POC): Making the client change now. Re-running load test — will paste logs in 30s.
ops-bot: [auto] alert: per-route-429s detected on tenant t-acme-9xx, sample-rate=0.03
Jordan (ACME POC): After reducing batch/concurrency we still saw a few 429s during the first ramp but much fewer. Sample failed response:
```
{"error":"rate_limited","message":"per-route capacity exceeded","retry_after":3,"route":"/v1/embeddings"}
```
Priya (oncall): OK. Eli — send tenant_id (t-acme-9xx) and confirm you approve a temporary uplift to 200 rps for 2 hours starting now. I'll run the change once approval is in the ticket.
Eli (sales): Confirmed. I approve temporary uplift for demo window. Recording here for audit: approved by Eli at 2025-11-02T12:10:00Z.
Devon (eng): Applied uplift: embeddings route = 200 rps for tenant t-acme-9xx, window 2025-11-02T12:12:00Z -> 2025-11-02T14:12:00Z. Auto-revert scheduled. Please monitor.
ops-bot: [auto] config_change: route_cap_update {tenant: "t-acme-9xx", route: "/v1/embeddings", old: "50", new: "200", actor: "Devon (eng)"}
Jordan (ACME POC): After uplift, demo run shows no 429s and stable p50 latency. Thanks everyone! 
Marin (solutions): For post-demo follow-up: propose client-side rate limiter and exponential backoff, and we should discuss preset POC cap increases in the onboarding flow.
Keiko (support): Also advising customer to reduce batch size for cost and stability. I'll open a follow-up support ticket with remediation steps and attach the logs.
Eli (sales): Great — Jordan, if you hit anything else ping me. Closing the swarm unless new errors surface. :thumbsup:
